applicability: The reviewer's first review read when it is opened with no subject and its subject catalogue has not answered.
conditions: The hold lasts at most SUBJECT_HOLD_MS (750 ms), after which the task-context review is read as for a refused catalogue.

Family examination: no joint obligation is supported. Basis: This bounds the reviewer's own read cycle; it is not part of what the task entry shows, so it does not support the entry family's guarantee, and no stored family guarantees reviewer read latency.
exclusions: What happens when the catalogue answers after the bound (auto-selection, focus), owned by L48.
statement: F1 (medium): the first-read hold must be bounded; a stalled or slow catalogue may not block the task-context review or source explorer, which base showed immediately.
